title: Rollbar Deploy
description: A Rollbar deployment record representing a code release. Deploys are used to correlate error spikes with specific releases and track which code version introduced issues.

id.description: The deploy ID assigned by Rollbar.

project_id.description: The project ID this deploy belongs to.

environment.description: The environment deployed to (e.g., production, staging, development).

revision.description: The revision identifier, typically a Git commit SHA or version string.

local_username.description: The local system username of the person who performed the deploy.

rollbar_username.description: The Rollbar username of the person who performed the deploy.

comment.description: An optional comment describing the deployment or changes included.

status.description: The status of the deployment lifecycle.

start_time.description: Unix timestamp when the deploy started.

finish_time.description: Unix timestamp when the deploy finished.

user_id.description: The Rollbar user ID who initiated the deploy.

DeployStatus.description: The lifecycle status of a deployment.
